page.notes: Printed "fortiuni" in line 7 may be a misprint for "fortuiti"; kept as printed, marked [?]. "praedestinamnr" in line 18 is a printing error (for "praedestinamur"), left as printed. The left-margin note "p.501." reads "p.soi." on the scan and is uncertain. The note "me. 121." beside line 32 is uncertain and was omitted from the transcription as its text is not clear. Italic names in line 30 are a best reading. The text ends with "funt" at the foot of the page; no catchword is visible. The page is not divided into chapters, so no heading is given.
